title: LLM judgments (engine input)
description: The only thing the LLM produces. Use as the structured-output schema for the call made with prompts/judge.md. engine/uw.py re-checks everything here and also verifies evidence quotes against source text.

tag.description: credit: a credit tag (STRIP_UNRESOLVED is the default) or unsure. debit_group: MCA, a debit tag, AMBIGUOUS_<LABEL> or unsure. character: LOW, ELEVATED, HIGH, INDETERMINATE or unsure, from the question's allowed list. document: CONTRACT, PAYOFF, UNRELATED or unsure.

failure_mode.description: character only, from the question's allowed list.

text.description: core_operation: at most 240 characters. character: at most 400.

terms.description: document only. quote is verbatim from the document and prints amount; date_quote is verbatim and prints good_through.

amount.description: CONTRACT: the payment per period. PAYOFF: the payoff balance. Digits, optional cents.

quote.description: Verbatim substring of the transaction description, or of the document when kind is document.
